primaryObjective: Make explicit witness-count evidence a typed, provenance-preserving descriptive assessment without treating missing, approximate, range, group, or party-size language as exact independent witnesses.
hypothesis: At least 116,231 NUFORC records can retain a typed witness-count evidence class with original text and uncertainty preserved, making a single-source descriptive assessment safely estimable while all cross-source and Pattern Finder comparisons remain suppressed.

inScope: immutable event-aligned witness-count sidecar preserving original value and source role
typed exact count, approximate count, bounded range, lower bound, qualitative plural, missing, invalid, and unresolved classes
single-source descriptive witness-count distribution with explicit source limitation
compact Analysis disclosure plus JSON and CSV evidence export
deterministic provenance, release, preview, production, and rollback receipts
outOfScope: treating missing witness count as zero or one
extracting witness counts from narrative descriptions
coercing couple, few, several, crowd, group, family, or party language to an exact count
treating party size as independently corroborating witnesses
cross-source comparison, incidence, credibility, authenticity, risk, or causal claims
Pattern Finder promotion or any assessment other than explicit witness-count evidence

requiredFields: typed measurement class and exact count only when explicit
lower and upper bounds only when explicitly supported
estimators: source-era-region comparison only if a future immutable release supplies at least two independently supported sources
readinessContract.uncertaintyTreatment: Original text, exact counts, approximate counts, ranges, lower bounds, qualitative plural language, party-size language, missing values, and invalid formats remain distinct. Only an explicit unambiguous integer becomes an exact witness count.
readinessContract.suppressionPolicy: Publish descriptive readiness and failure counts only. Suppress active/reference inference, source holdouts, Pattern Finder, and credibility or incidence interpretations while the evidence is limited to one source.

releaseGates: original-value preservation, typed uncertainty separation, and idempotence
exact, approximate, range, lower-bound, qualitative, missing, invalid, and extreme-value tests
single-source descriptive-only enforcement and Pattern Finder isolation
no narrative count extraction, missing-as-zero, credibility, incidence, or causal promotion
Pages and R2 separation with immutable versioned R2 keys
desktop and mobile browser QA, keyboard, themes, reduced motion, exports, and zero console errors
identical frozen Pages package preview to production and tested rollback
stopConditions: fewer than 116231 rows retain typed witness-count evidence without canonical repair or narrative extraction
exact counts cannot remain distinct from approximate, range, qualitative, party-size, missing, and invalid values
a material product gain would require cross-source or credibility inference from the one-source corpus
rights or provenance cannot be resolved
performance or existing Analysis behavior regresses beyond release gates
